title: Repair Estimates & Appointments Settings: Reserved Capacity, Open Bookings and No-Show Counting
content:
These settings of Repair Estimates & Appointments govern how a customer's no-shows are counted, how many open bookings a vehicle may carry and which estimate types reserve bay or estimator capacity for a specific slot.

| Estimate type | No-show look-back (calendar days) | No-show limit | Open bookings per vehicle | Reserved slot |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 365 | 2 | 1 | No |
| Drive-In Estimate | 365 | 2 | 1 | No |
| Scheduled Estimate | 365 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| Mobile Estimate | 365 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 365 | 2 | 1 | Yes |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 365 | 2 | 1 | Yes |

- **No-show look-back** — the length of the rolling look-back window for counting a customer's no-shows, in calendar days.
- **No-show limit** — the no-show count within the look-back window at which reserved-slot types can no longer be booked.
- **Open bookings per vehicle** — the most bookings one vehicle may have open at once (booked, checked in or estimate written).
- **Reserved slot** — whether the type reserves bay or estimator capacity for a specific slot.

The look-back, the limit and the open-booking cap are the same for every type (365 days, 2 no-shows, 1 open booking); the Scheduled, Mobile, Blueprint Teardown and Structural Blueprint Estimates reserve a slot, the Photo and Drive-In Estimates do not.
